activation.title: Activate Warranty

activation.success: Warranty activated and anchored to your wallet.

ownership.portalSubtitle: Manage owned units, generate one-time resale transfer codes, or file warranty claims with zero XLM required.
ownership.redeemSubtitle: Buying a second-hand item? Enter the Unit ID and seller's one-time code to claim ownership and preserve its remaining warranty.

warranty.claimSubtitle: Select your unit, describe the defect, and attach up to 3 evidence photos.
warranty.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the issue, when it started, and any visible damage...
warranty.dropzoneHint: Drag & drop photos here, or click to browse (serial sticker, damage area, receipt)

recalls.bannerMessage: This production batch has been recalled by the manufacturer. Please stop using the product and contact an authorized service center.

wallet.modalSubtitle: Choose a wallet provider to sign transactions and manage your Veritag assets.
wallet.passkeyDesc: Biometric FaceID / TouchID / Windows Hello smart wallet (secp256r1).
wallet.albedoDesc: Instant browser popup signing with zero installation.

passkey.onboardingSubtitle: Use your device biometrics to sign Stellar Soroban transactions securely — no passwords or seed phrases.
passkey.supportedMessage: Your device supports hardware-backed platform passkeys.
passkey.fallbackGuidance: Your browser or device did not report a built-in biometric authenticator. You can still use a hardware security key (e.g., YubiKey), a password manager passkey, or our WebCrypto fallback.
passkey.troubleshootSteps: Ensure popups and WebAuthn are enabled for this site, and verify you are using HTTPS or localhost.
